finalText:
Perfect! All tests are passing now. The bug was in the `isExpired` function on line 7 of `token.js`. It was using `<` instead of `<=`, so tokens weren't marked as expired at the exact moment of expiration — only *after* that moment had passed. This allowed expired tokens to slip through.

The fix was a one-character change: `token.exp < nowSeconds` → `token.exp <= nowSeconds`. This aligns with the documented behavior that "a token is considered expired the moment `exp` is reached."
